newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Analysts see no Portugal repo rate cut on Wed.
newsitem.headline: Analysts see no Portugal repo rate cut on Wed.

text.p: Six out of seven analysts at leading Lisbon banks and brokerages polled by Reuters ruled out any cut in the repurchase agreement rate when the Bank of Portugal announces conditions for the next commercial bank reserve period on Wednesday.
The analysts were asked the following questions:
1. Will the Bank of Portugal cut its 6.9-percent repo rate on Wednesday?
2. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the repo before the end of the year?
3. In the case of the answer to number two being affirmative, how much will it cut?
The analysts gave the following replies:
3. The two analysts who expected a rate cut before the end of the year saw 15 to 20 basis points coming off the repo rate.
The following banks and brokerages took part in the survey: Siemca, Banco de Comercio & Industria, Banco Mello and Fincor. The other participants declined to be identified.
